visual_review.scope: One stronger native G7 finish on the same REVISED body as the user reference; original WIDE_ROOT_FINISHED design checkpoint remains separate and unchanged.
visual_review.visible_result: Matched all-flat macro comparison shows clear geometric change. Previously faint comb regions have raised diagonal ridges and scale-like shadows over broad folded strips. Close view shows the pattern following the existing large S folds while valleys retain open areas.
visual_review.whole_column: Full front silhouette and major fold organization look almost unchanged at the recorded camera scale. Body-oblique view gains a subtler surface grain. This is a near-detail development rather than a replacement of the large column form.
visual_review.technical_result: Six-triangle short-ridge disks replace source four-fan disks within selected fine quad boundaries. All original control corners and oriented boundaries are retained. Native positions, indices and all-flat flags are verified against saved candidate arrays before and after rendering.
visual_review.limits: Some larger cells now read as angular triangular or diamond plates. Existing blunt cup ends and awkward sheet overlaps remain. Do not claim natural Baroque end repair, reference-level completion, fabrication readiness or global collision freedom.
visual_review.independent_review: Separate read-only agent reviewed all four actual source/candidate views and recommended keeping this as a clearly visible design candidate, without another automatic candidate.
visual_review.aesthetic_question: User asked to choose whether to retain current clear broad comb and reduce only coarser plates, or retain coverage and lower ridge height for a finer expression. No additional candidate is generated while that future design choice is pending.
visual_review.diagnostic_scope: Source fan pitch and new central roof-wing pitch refer to different facet sets. Their distributions document construction strength and must not be presented as an aesthetic score or a direct identical-face improvement ratio.
